## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes, after the build (so the checks on the built pages run too). New behaviour has a test.
- [ ] No secrets: no passwords, tokens or keys anywhere; vault references only.
- [ ] No personal or real data: no real hostnames, serials, addresses, people, tickets or photos of real offices. Demo data stays fictional.
- [ ] Device facts are cited in `data/sources/`.
- [ ] Pages checked at phone and desktop width, in light and dark, with reduced motion on (for page changes).
- [ ] A line under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, if people will notice the change.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), for the DCO. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
